# Documentation

## Pages

- [Introduction](https://www.better-agent.com/docs): A TypeScript framework for building typed, event-driven, framework-agnostic agent apps.
- [Concepts](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/concepts): Core Better Agent concepts.
- [Agent](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/concepts/agent): The fundamental building block of Better Agent.
- [Auth](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/concepts/auth): Resolve request identity for agents, memory, and plugins.
- [Client](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/concepts/client): Call agents from your frontend.
- [Errors](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/concepts/errors): Handle run, HTTP, stream, and validation errors.
- [Events](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/concepts/events): Stream AG-UI events from agent runs.
- [Human in the Loop](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/concepts/hil): Pause runs for human approval and user input.
- [MCP](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/concepts/mcp): Connect agents to MCP servers.
- [Memory](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/concepts/memory): Let agents remember conversations across runs.
- [Plugins](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/concepts/plugins): Add app-wide behavior to every agent.
- [State](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/concepts/state): Track working data during a run.
- [Storage](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/concepts/storage): Persist runtime data for memory, runs, and streams.
- [Structured Output](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/concepts/structured-output): Return validated data from an agent.
- [Tools](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/concepts/tools): Let agents call functions during a run.
- [TypeScript](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/concepts/typescript): Share agent types across server and client.
- [Databases](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/database): Storage adapters for durable Better Agent data.
- [Drizzle](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/database/drizzle): Drizzle ORM adapter for Better Agent.
- [Kysely](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/database/kysely): Kysely adapter for Better Agent.
- [Prisma](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/database/prisma): Prisma adapter for Better Agent.
- [Redis](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/database/redis): Redis adapter for Better Agent.
- [Get Started](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/get-started): Install Better Agent, define your first agent, and run it.
- [Integrations](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/integrations): Framework integrations.
- [Astro](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/integrations/astro): Use Better Agent with Astro.
- [Elysia](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/integrations/elysia): Use Better Agent with Elysia.
- [Express](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/integrations/express): Use Better Agent with Express.
- [Fastify](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/integrations/fastify): Use Better Agent with Fastify.
- [Hono](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/integrations/hono): Use Better Agent with Hono.
- [NestJS](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/integrations/nestjs): Use Better Agent with NestJS.
- [Next.js](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/integrations/nextjs): Use Better Agent with Next.js App Router.
- [Nuxt](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/integrations/nuxt): Use Better Agent with Nuxt.
- [Remix](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/integrations/remix): Use Better Agent with Remix.
- [SolidStart](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/integrations/solidstart): Use Better Agent with SolidStart.
- [SvelteKit](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/integrations/sveltekit): Use Better Agent with SvelteKit.
- [TanStack Start](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/integrations/tanstack-start): Use Better Agent with TanStack Start.
- [Plugins](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/plugins): Available plugins.
- [IP Allowlist](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/plugins/ip-allowlist): IP and CIDR allowlist plugin.
- [Logging](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/plugins/logging): Structured runtime logging plugin.
- [Rate Limit](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/plugins/rate-limit): Windowed request rate limiting plugin.
- [Sandbox](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/plugins/sandbox): Sandbox workspace tools for agents.
- [Providers](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/providers): Supported AI providers.
- [Vercel AI SDK](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/providers/ai-sdk): Use AI SDK-compatible models.
- [Anthropic](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/providers/anthropic): Use Anthropic Claude models and hosted tools.
- [Gemini](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/providers/gemini): Use Google Gemini models and hosted tools.
- [Ollama](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/providers/ollama): Run local models with Ollama.
- [OpenAI](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/providers/openai): Use OpenAI models and hosted tools.
- [OpenRouter](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/providers/openrouter): Use OpenRouter models.
- [Workers AI](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/providers/workers-ai): Use Cloudflare Workers AI models.
- [xAI](https://www.better-agent.com/docs/providers/xai): Use xAI models and hosted tools.
